_comment: The recorded shape of main's live required-status-check contexts, for the
required-contexts class in policy_lint.mjs (#957). The linter asks the
endpoint named below -- a clone whose origin is a local path or a fork
still asks THIS repository, because the corpus's claims are about it --
reads the branch endpoint AND the ruleset objects (bypass-aware; the
branch endpoint alone is not) and reddens on any name OR ruleset id the
live set and this shape disagree on, so the next ruleset change reddens
the tree within one push. `rulesets` records the ids the derivation READ
the contexts out of -- the branch endpoint's required_status_checks rule's
ruleset_id -- and a fixture naming none fires rather than skipping (#1300).
When it reddens: re-record THIS file by hand from the API, never by copying
the linter's message, and re-read every assertion site against the new
list. An unreachable or rate-limited API must NOT redden this class
(policy-docs is itself a required context; a transient outage must not
block every merge), which is why a failed fetch is a printed skip, never a
finding.
The default-branch boundary spans TWO rulesets, and only the second is
recorded here: `main-protect` 22628467 carries deletion and
non-fast-forward (the push surface, no required context -- naming it here
was the #1300 defect, because the drift check then compared contexts
against a ruleset that supplies none), while `main-protect-checks`
23698884 carries the required contexts, the `pull_request` review rule and
the deploy key's `always` bypass -- everything this file is about.
_ruleset_objects: Each ruleset object as the API returns it, less RULESET_VOLATILE (counts.mjs), recorded by hand from GET repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/rulesets/23698884 on 2026-09-27. It records the ruleset as it stands, dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push false included: tvofi left that setting unchanged (round 9, D11-s1-01 refused).
